propositions: Baseline storage must normalize ADF-shaped description through normalize_rich_text and store Jira status/priority as exact name strings rather than vendor dicts to reduce file size by ~66%.
The normalization projection must be idempotent for already-scalar values, preserve field absence, and apply only to description/status/priority while excluding summary and assignee.
Assignee field must remain unchanged as a complete vendor dict to preserve all identity forms and prevent local-wins overwrites of concurrent remote edits.
The pre-A3 reader already accepts both scalar and vendor-dict forms of description/status/priority through the existing inbound_mapper path, ensuring safe rollback without migration.

Live comparison results (fields/conflicts/dropped outcome) must be identical whether baseline stores ADF/Jira dicts or their normalized scalar equivalents, verified through compute_update_fields with real mappers.
